title: Her fancyman is treating two Royal Dublins in O’Loughlin’s of Blackpitts.
html_source:
fancyman: a woman’s lover.

Even though Stephen’s mind has once again wandered to far-flung locales, his fancies always circle back to his life in Ireland. “Blackpitts” is an area of Dublin named for the large amounts of mass graves nearby.

“Royal Dublins” are probably people who frequent the Royal Dublin golf course, implying wealth and status, something working-class Stephen doesn’t have.
